$description: Rules here and RULES in schema/semantic_validate.py are two sources for one fact; verify_all.py fails if their ids diverge.

toneModel.sequence: light+ (ending at the handoff section) then inverse+

rules.description: PageSpec.route must be one of the declared template's routes.
Every node's section must be a node of the DECLARED template (cross-referenced against templates.json, not checked in isolation).
No section repeats; every template node is repeatable:false. Keyed on (section, variant) in the message.
Nodes must follow the template's node order exactly (optional nodes may be skipped, never moved).
Every required template node must be present (header, hero, dark transition, footer).
Omitting an optional node is valid but unmeasured: the only real composition contains all 12.
variant must be in the template node's allowedVariants.
anchorId must equal the template node's anchorId (dark transition and shell have none).
Each node's tone must equal its template node's tone.

Exactly one light->inverse handoff, at transition.light-to-dark: header and every main node up to and including it are light; every main node after it and the footer are inverse. No light section may follow it.
handoff must be the template's observed value or null (hero/logo: light, security: inverse, others: null). A generator may drop a Handoff, never add or retone one.
A Handoff's tone must equal the wrapped section's tone (overlay .12 light / .6 inverse).
A Handoff-wrapped section must be inside <main> and followed by another <main> section that scrolls over it.
features.send-slideshow reads #send-scroll-trigger, which lives in proof.logo-ticker; Logo must directly precede Send.
motion.reducedMotionFallback must be the section's pinned value.
The node's motion block must equal its section contract (no invented, altered or missing motion).
Text within maxChars/maxWords; explicit-line fields have exactly the measured line count; lists have the measured item counts.
assetRole must be in the closed enum AND allowed for that media slot.
config.waitlistEndpoint is required, https, and never the source company's live endpoint, in BOTH modes (the clone itself replaced the live POST with a no-op).
Every '/#id' link must point at an anchorId of a node present on the page.
A node's retrievalEligible (when given) must equal the section contract's, and the contract must agree with the RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE code pin.
nodes[].styleTokens values are token ids; raw hex/rgb/hsl/named colours and raw dimensions are rejected.
styleTokens.sectionPaddingY must be a spacing.scale.* id from the measured scale.
styleTokens.fontFamily must be a supported font token (fontFamily.sans = Inter Variable).
Every styleTokens value must exist in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json and be of the category the slot accepts.
A color.* id in a color slot must be what the node's tone theme resolves that role group to (e.g. no light-theme text colour on an inverse node).
mode=generation: no source brand name/variant/domain (schema/source-leakage-patterns.json BRAND), no brand.* role, no source brand file.
mode=generation: no real partner/customer name (CUSTOMER patterns) anywhere, no partner.logo role or partner logo file.
mode=generation: no real person's photo (photo.portrait / -ascii / reflection roles, portrait files); use fictional.person.
mode=generation: no real source app screen / card / share image (roles or files); use placeholder.screenshot.
mode=generation: no other clone-only asset role or source asset file; every media role must be generation-safe (PINNED_AVAILABILITY).
mode=generation: no source copy (sha256 of any 5-word shingle, whole 3-4 word phrase or legacy full-string fingerprint).
mode=generation: no source claim (speed/fee/number statements, hashed as COPY).
mode=generation: no source URL/host (fingerprints) and every absolute URL on a reserved *.example / *.invalid host (store, social and embed URLs included).
Both modes: external link hrefs are https.

modeModel.clone: private faithful reconstruction; source brand/copy/assets/partner names/social URLs allowed for fidelity
modeModel.generation: page for another brand; every GENERATION_MODE_* rule applies
modeModel.failClosed: a spec whose mode is not exactly 'clone' is checked as generation
